title: Trusted testers on their own machines: everything they do recorded and sent to the owner's private records repository
request: The owner wants trusted friends to clone the repository and use DCLab locally, with everything they do recorded and fetched back; a private GitHub repository, records plus the tables a tester agrees to, each tester's own key.
spec: dclab_rnd testers (setup, share, collect, summary) and its command line, the make targets, the owner's evaluation reading the collected testers, docs/guides/TESTERS.md.
plan: Show the notice and need the tester's agreement before anything is set.
Send only what changed, whole files with a manifest of their hashes, through git.
Rebuild each tester's workspace on the owner's side, applying only what matches its manifest and stays inside the tester's folder.

decisions.decision: A table goes only with the tester's yes, asked again when its content changes, and without it its cells are taken out of the records that quote them.
decisions.why: A no to a table must mean its values do not leave, not just its file.

decisions.decision: A tester's workspace must keep its records in files.
decisions.why: On PostgreSQL the records are in the database and a share would send almost nothing, silently.

change: dclab_rnd/testers (new), Makefile, dclab_rnd/evaluation.py, .gitignore, .env.example, README, docs, tests/test_testers.py (new).

findings.defect: Two shares in the same second overwrote each other's bundle and lost files.
findings.scenario: A second share replaced the first's manifest; its files were never collected nor sent again.
findings.cause: The bundle folder was named to the second.
findings.fix: Bundles are named to the microsecond with a random suffix, so they never meet and stay in order of time.

findings.defect: A bundle committed offline was never pushed.
findings.scenario: After a share without push, the next share found nothing new and stopped before pushing.
findings.cause: Files were marked shared at commit time.
findings.fix: A file is marked shared only once pushed; a share first pushes any commit not yet pushed; a rejected push pulls and tries once more.

findings.defect: A refused table's values still left inside the records.
findings.scenario: A project's previews, a draft's top values and an intern session's examples quoted cells of a table the tester said no to.
findings.fix: Without the table's yes, the keys that quote cells are taken out of the project, draft and session records sent.

findings.defect: On PostgreSQL a share sent almost nothing.
findings.scenario: The guide offered make dev, which keeps records in the database.
findings.cause: The records live in the database there.
findings.fix: Setup and share refuse a workspace on PostgreSQL; the guide says make notebook with the database setting empty.

findings.scenario: The owner's records path and a workspace folder set in .env were ignored.
findings.cause: The command did not load the file the server loads.

findings.defect: A share did not check consent.
findings.scenario: With the workspace's consent turned off, a share still sent everything.
findings.cause: Consent was set at setup and never read again.
findings.fix: A share refuses when the workspace's consent is off.

findings.defect: A table's yes was remembered by its path only.
findings.scenario: New real data under the name of an earlier sample was sent without asking.
findings.cause: The answer was keyed by path.
findings.fix: The answer is kept with the table's hash and asked again when it changes; earlier answers can be forgotten.

findings.defect: A file was hashed before it was copied.
findings.scenario: An appended event between the two made the copy disagree with its manifest and be skipped silently.
findings.cause: The hash was taken from the source.
findings.fix: The copy is hashed; skipped files are counted and said.

findings.defect: One malformed manifest stopped the whole collection.
findings.scenario: A bundle with a broken manifest raised and no tester was collected.
findings.cause: Nothing caught a manifest that could not be read.
findings.fix: Such a bundle is skipped and said; the others are applied.

findings.scenario: A project the tester deleted stayed on the owner's side forever.
findings.fix: The manifest names the files deleted since the last share and the collection deletes them.

findings.defect: A link inside a bundle was followed when reading.
findings.scenario: A bundle's file that linked to an owner's file copied it into the tester's folder.
findings.cause: Sources were not checked for links.
findings.fix: A link, a source outside the bundle or a destination outside the tester's folder is never applied.

findings.defect: The cap was not set when a line already existed.
findings.scenario: An empty or higher monthly cap stayed while the notice promised fifteen.
findings.cause: Setup only added a missing line.
findings.fix: A missing, empty or higher cap is set to fifteen; a lower one stays.

findings.defect: The owner's records clone was not ignored by git.
findings.scenario: Every tester's records could have been committed to the code repository.
findings.cause: The folder was not in the ignore list.
findings.fix: It is in the ignore list.

outcome: Testers can share their records and agreed tables; the owner collects them; tested on a local bare repository.
lessons: A no to sharing a file must also cover every other file that quotes it.
Mark a thing sent only when it has left.
risks: In one shared repository a tester could write into another's folder.
